create_speech_to_speech_dataset: create a SpeechToSpeechDataset instance with source and target audio paths, frame counts, and language tags
load_s2s_dataset_from_tsv: load a SpeechToSpeechDataset from TSV manifest files using SpeechToSpeechDatasetCreator.from_tsv with root path and splits
pack_units_frames: pack multiple target frames per step into single token IDs using the pack_units method
collate_s2s_samples: collate a batch of SpeechToSpeechDatasetItem samples into a batched dictionary with source tokens and target tokens
add_multitask_dataset: add a multitask dataset to a SpeechToSpeechMultitaskDataset instance using the add_multitask_dataset method
